meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For **acne-prone skin under ₹700 in India**, I’d pick based on whether you have active pimples or mainly acne marks:

### 🥇 Best overall: The Derma Co 2% Sali-Cinamide Serum
### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹347*

It combines **2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide**, so it targets clogged pores/active acne while also helping oiliness and post-acne marks. The brand currently lists it at ₹449, below your ₹700 budget. [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Other good choices

### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹549*

### [The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹207.90*

### [Minimalist 05% Niacinamide Face Serum 30 ml]()
*₹569.10*

- **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid** — best if your main issue is **active acne, blackheads and clogged pores**. Current listed price is around ₹549. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.1mg.com](https://www.1mg.com/categories/skin-care/face-serums-4432?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid** — good **budget option** if you want straightforward acne treatment; the 10 ml version is currently around ₹249. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.1mg.com](https://www.1mg.com/categories/skin-care/face-serums-4432?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Minimalist 5% Niacinamide** — better if you have **sensitive/acne-prone skin or mostly acne marks/oiliness**, rather than frequent active breakouts. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.1mg.com](https://www.1mg.com/categories/skin-care/face-serums-4432?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My pick:** If you get regular pimples + oily/clogged pores, buy **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**. Start **2–3 nights per week**, then increase if your skin tolerates it. Don't combine it initially with other strong exfoliating acids or retinoids, and use sunscreen during the day.

If you tell me whether your skin is **oily, dry, combination, or sensitive** and whether you have **active pimples or mostly acne marks**, I can narrow it down to one.
